answer: Weight each agent's influence by the square root of its committed, cipher-bound stake instead of counting identities one-for-one. A single honest voice stays a clear signal, but a Sybil that shards one pile of capital across 1000 clones buys only the root of 1000 (about 32x) the pull, so every clone fades to a faint whisper. Doubling real influence then demands QUADRUPLING genuine stake, capital an attacker cannot forge because each unit is bound to an on-ledger key. Fragmenting into cheap identities now drains voice rather than amplifying it.
